Repeat the link measurements and the declared endpoint test. Arrival at the balcony is not evidence of recovery.
A reflective closing melody follows the recorded outcome.
Declared check passed; scope shown in text
The Steady Light: the permanent route passed its declared checks. The maintenance record remembers how you got here.
The Iron City is the next realm. This episode ends here; your return path remains available.
A permanent repair needs a maintenance plan, too. The next apprentice deserves a useful record.
Try the known pattern again over the repaired route. Compare what arrived with what was sent.
A steady light, a fresh check, and a record someone else can follow. That is a promising morning.

endings.title: The Steady Light
endings.text:
The Steady Light

The current evidence has been classified. Review its outcome and caveats before continuing.

Game
Sound and reading

The beacon above the Iron Threshold settles into a steady glow. For once, the enormous gate has nothing to complain about. You close the test record, leaving the observations beside the conclusion where the next engineer can find them.

Below, the Rift is still a scar in the stone. It is no longer an excuse for an outage. The Underworld has a working connection and a record of how you proved it. Beyond the gate, the Iron City keeps its own unfinished chapter.

Skip scene

Permanent restoration: the repaired route passed its physical checks and the separate endpoint service test.

Your record follows the fiber route through the Photon Gardens and Prism Vault. Inspection, compatibility and measured loss share the page; a bright-looking path never stood in for those checks.

Photon the Firefly joined your circle of companions, a small light for the road ahead.

Copperhead Snake joined your circle of companions. There is always room for one more careful observer.

Single-Mode Unicorn is in your chosen party. The notebook receives a solemn nod and, mercifully, no hoofprint.

Multimode Hydra is in your chosen party. Several heads inspect the handover; it remains one handover.

Thunderbird joined your circle of companions. There are more journeys to share after this one.

SFP Hermit Crab joined your circle of companions, bringing an impressive collection of empty shells.

Electric Eel joined your circle of companions. Your next workshop visit will have a familiar face.

Echo Bat joined your circle of companions. The news was announced twice.

Chameleon joined your circle of companions. A familiar face, however unfamiliar the colour.

The main journey has a chapter of its own.

Continue returns to the safe Iron Threshold. Earlier rooms remain available. The Iron City is a future episode boundary, not a missing puzzle.
